definitions.explanation: A person who raises dairy cattle and produces milk and other dairy products as their livelihood.

examples.japanese: ⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{酪農家|らくのうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There are many dairy farmers in Hokkaido.

examples.japanese: {酪農家|らくのうか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早く：02935_hayaku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{搾乳|さくにゅう}→搾乳：24182_sakunyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Dairy farmers milk the cows from early every morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飼料|しりょう}→飼料：19666_shiryou⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高騰|こうとう}→高騰：14647_koutou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{酪農家|らくのうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苦|くる}しんでいる→苦しむ：01938_kurushimu⟧。
examples.english: Due to soaring feed prices, many dairy farmers are struggling financially.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{酪農|らくのう}→酪農：06104_rakunou⟧ (dairy farming) + ⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧ (professional/practitioner). Hokkaido is the center of Japanese dairy farming, producing over half of the country's raw milk.
